label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — resolved sink value is host = request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') which is attacker-controlled. Although the code performs DNS resolution and checks isNonPublicAddress(), this validation has critical flaws: (1) DNS rebinding attack possible between resolution time and connection time, (2) validation only checks specific address types (loopback/site-local/link-local/any-local) but misses other private ranges, (3) the separate DNS resolution and outbound fetch pattern inherently enables SSRF. The sink at L44 executes connectHttpByHostname(host) with unvalidated user-supplied host parameter reaching the network call.

evidence.note: User input extracted from request parameter
DNS resolution followed by connection to user-controlled host - SSRF vulnerability
isNonPublicAddress only checks limited address types, allowing other private/internal IPs
